content.visible_text: Skip to Content About Schedule Youth Program FAQs Contact Premier Muay Thai Training in San Francisco California Martial Athletics has been raising the bar for martial arts and fitness since 2019. Biggest Muay Thai Gym in San Francisco Two-Level Facility: 4,500+ sq ft across two levels for Muay Thai classes, bag work, strength, and conditioning Full boxing ring + 9 heavy bags Strength + conditioning area with weights, cardio equipment, and assault bikes Beginner-Friendly Environment: Classes for every level 30+ Weekly Classes: Offered mornings, midday, and evenings Elite Coaches: 25+ years guiding casual members to competitive fighters View Schedule Amenities CMA gives you everything you need for a complete training experience. Our facility is clean, comfortable, and built to support every part of your training routine. Women’s & Men’s locker rooms with showers and an all-gender restroom Secure storage for your gear and personal items Open mat space for stretching, warm-ups, and extra training Transportation & ParkinG California Martial Athletics is located on Polk Street, between Bush and Sutter, in the heart of San Francisco. Street parking, parking garages, and multiple public transit stops are nearby. Polk-Bush Garage: 1399 Bush St Civic Center Bart Station Muni: 19, 49, 14 reviews "I highly recommend this place! It's refueled my passion for martial arts and I couldn't be happier to have found an incredible gym community." Samantha A. San Francisco, CA "They'll make sure you learn and work out hard, but they also stress timing and technique so you learn the right way." Nikky L. Washington, DC "There are so many great things to say about CMA. All the coaches are incredibly knowledgeable and push you without creating a hostile environment" Michael L.
